extension.summary: Full-screen 2026 Rave UI for Rave Player, with Spinning Surprise.
Full-screen 2026 Rave UI for Rave Player, with Spinning Surprise.
extension.description: The primary Rave Player app: one full-screen Kodi window with all ten rooms, paged lists, an in-window keyboard search, favourites, downloads, live radio, About and Spinning Surprise. Drives the Rave Player plugin as its data and playback backend. Back exits cleanly; the plugin's Classic lists remain available as the fallback.
